newsitem.title: UK: Royal U.S. subsidiary to buy BNH.
newsitem.headline: Royal U.S. subsidiary to buy BNH.

text.p: The Royal Bank of Scotland said on Tuesday that its U.S. subsidiary Citizens Financial Group Inc is to buy BNH Bancshares Inc for $57 million in cash.
BNH is the parent of Bank of New Haven and currently has around $350 million of assets and operates from 11 branches in and around New Haven.
Royal, which owns 76.5 percent of Citizens, said the acquisition will strengthen Citizens supercommunity franchise in Connecticut to 41 branches.
The Bank of Ireland owns the remaining 23.5 percent of Citizens.
Completion is expected to take place in the late summer of 1997.
Citizens will finance the acquisition from its own resources.
